mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compensation_log (action_key, handler, payload, status, attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{record.actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.handler,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.payload,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{record.attempts,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{record.updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{record.updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.update: UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'EXECUTED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_key = #{actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'COMPENSATING', claim_token = #{claimToken,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_key = #{actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'FAILED')
UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'COMPENSATED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_key = #{actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'COMPENSATING')

UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'FAILED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_key = #{actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'EXECUTED', 'COMPENSATING')
UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE action_key = #{actionKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND status IN ('EXECUTED', 'COMPENSATING')

UPDATE compensation_log SET status = 'EXECUTED', claim_token = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'COMPENSATING' AND claimed_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'EXECUTED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
SELECT * FROM compensation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
